intro.title: Roulette tutorial
intro.body: You will learn roulette inside the real game screen, with a demo balance. Tutorial actions do not spend your real chips.

header.title: Navigation
header.body: The top bar lets you leave roulette and confirms that you are on the roulette table.

balance.title: Balance
balance.body: This counter shows your available chips. In a real round, the spin stakes your bets and automatically credits payouts.

wheel.title: Wheel and spin
wheel.body: The wheel receives the server-calculated result. The ball lands on that number, then the result panel updates.

chips.title: Choose chips
chips.body: Tap one or more chips to build the amount you want to place. Available values follow your current level limits.

pending.title: Stack to place
pending.body: This stack is the amount ready to be placed. It stays here until you tap a betting spot on the table.

straight.title: Straight-up number
straight.body: Tapping one number places the whole stack on that exact number. It is the riskiest bet, with the highest payout.

outside.title: Outside bets
outside.body: Red, black, even, odd, low and high cover large groups of numbers. They win more often, with a smaller payout.

dozens.title: Dozens
dozens.body: The three dozens cover 1-12, 13-24 and 25-36. Zero belongs to no dozen.

columns.title: Columns
columns.body: Columns follow the vertical alignments on the table. Like dozens, each column covers 12 numbers.

advanced.title: Inside bets
advanced.body: This panel groups splits, streets, corners and six-lines. Use it when you want to bet on neighboring numbers.

controls.title: Total and limits
controls.body: This area summarizes the amount placed, the caps, and gives you Undo or Clear all before spinning.

spin.title: Spin
spin.body: Once at least one bet is placed, this button spins the ball. In the tutorial, it only plays a demo.

result.title: Result
result.body: After the spin, the last number and its color appear here so you can quickly check what landed.

history.title: History
history.body: History details the round's bets, line-by-line payouts and net result. It helps explain why a bet paid.

finish.title: Ready to play
finish.body: You now know the full flow: build a stack, choose table spots, check the stake, spin, then read the result and history.

desc.royalFlush: The strongest hand: 10, jack, queen, king, and ace of the same suit.
desc.straightFlush: Five cards of the same suit in sequence, other than 10–J–Q–K–A (that is a royal flush, above).

help.tourWelcomeBody: We’ll walk through the felt, the pot, the board, and every action type. Esc or click outside to exit.
help.headerBody: Logo, street badge (Pre-Flop through Showdown). Side menu: guided tour, quantum probabilities, hidden bets, profile, friends. Chips (+ add in demo), chat, and desktop tour shortcut.
help.tableBody: Players sit around the felt. The “D” marks the dealer (blinds rotate). Chips in front of each seat show the current street’s bets. Burned cards may be shown when the phase displays them.
help.potBody: The pot is all chips committed to this hand — what you’re playing for. With multiple all-ins at different stack sizes, side pots can appear under the POT pill: each line is a pot and its amount.
help.boardBody: Flop: 3 shared cards, then Turn (4th), then River (5th). You make your best 5-card hand from your 2 hole cards + these 5. The FLOP / TURN / RIVER labels show each street.
help.actionsBody: Your hole cards and the countdown when it’s your turn. Fold: leave the hand. Call: match the current bet. Check: stay in for free when no bet is facing you. Raise: increase the bet (pick an amount or go all-in). Bets and Probabilities open their panels; on desktop you can also open chat from the top bar.
help.actionsSpectatorBody: As a spectator you watch the hand. Use the bottom button to queue for the next hand or cancel.
help.tourDoneBody: Open the tour anytime: Menu → Guided tour. Good luck!

adminConsole.loginSubtitle: Restricted access — configure credentials on the server.
adminConsole.loginError: Invalid credentials or console not configured.
adminConsole.notConfiguredHelp:
The API will not allow login until admin credentials are set on the server (this is not a browser bug).

1. In the backend env file (e.g. server/.env), set both variables:
   ADMIN_CONSOLE_USERNAME="your_username"
   ADMIN_CONSOLE_PASSWORD_HASH="$2a$10$..."  (bcrypt hash of the password, not the plain password)

2. Generate the hash from the server folder:
   node -e "require('bcryptjs').hash('YourPassword',10).then(console.log)"

3. Restart the Node API and try again.

See server/.env.example (ADMIN_CONSOLE_* section).

intro.title: Welcome to the table
intro.body: In Texas Hold'em, you make the best 5-card hand from your 2 private cards plus the 5 community cards. We'll play one full hand together: pre-flop, flop, turn, river, and showdown.

seats.title: The table: 2 seats
seats.body: You sit at the bottom, the bot is across from you. This tutorial is heads-up (1 vs 1). In real games, tables can have 2 to 9 players.

dealer.title: The dealer button
dealer.body: The white "D" disc marks the dealer of the hand. It rotates each hand. Heads-up, the button posts the small blind and acts first pre-flop, then last on every other street.

blinds.title: The blinds: forced bets
blinds.body: Before any card is dealt, two players post "blinds": small (SB = 10) and big (BB = 20). Here you post the small, the bot posts the big. Starting pot: 30.

deal.title: Your hole cards
deal.body: You receive 2 private cards only you see: here A♥ K♥. A premium hand — Ace and King of the same suit, perfect to win big.

preflopExplain.title: Your pre-flop options
preflopExplain.body: You have three choices: fold (give up), call (pay to stay), or raise (bet more). With A♥ K♥ we almost always raise.

preflopRaise.title: Raise to 60
preflopRaise.body: A standard open is 3× the BB, so 60. It builds the pot with a strong hand and pressures the opponent.

preflopBotCalls.title: The bot calls
preflopBotCalls.body: The bot pays the difference to stay in. The pot is now 120. On to the flop.

flop.title: The flop: 3 community cards
flop.body: The dealer reveals 3 cards in the middle: 2♥ 7♥ K♣. These are shared by everyone — you combine them with your 2 hole cards to make the best 5-card hand.

flopRead.title: You hit top pair + flush draw
flopRead.body: With your K♥ you make a pair of Kings (the best pair possible). Plus you have 4 ♥ cards (A♥ K♥ + 2♥ 7♥): one more ♥ and you hit the flush.

flopBet.title: Continuation bet: 80
flopBet.body: Standard play: keep representing a strong hand. A c-bet around half pot to two-thirds is enough.

flopBotCalls.title: The bot calls
flopBotCalls.body: Another call. Pot is now 280. On to the turn.

turn.title: The turn: 4th community card
turn.body: A new community card: J♥. The board now reads 2♥ 7♥ K♣ J♥.

turnFlush.title: Flush completed!
turnFlush.body: With A♥ K♥ + 2♥ 7♥ J♥ on the board, you have 5 ♥ cards: an ace-high flush! One of the strongest hands. Time to grow the pot.

turnRaise.title: Raise to 350
turnRaise.body: The bot bet 100 to try to push you off your draw. You already have the flush: raise 3.5× to scoop more chips.

turnBotCalls.title: The bot calls
turnBotCalls.body: The bot has a strong pair and won't fold. Pot: 980. River coming.

river.title: The river: 5th community card
river.body: Last community card: 3♠. It doesn't change your hand — you keep your ace-high flush.

riverBet.title: Value bet: 400
riverBet.body: You know the bot probably has a pair or trips. Big sizing to get max value: this is called a "value bet".

showdownReveal.title: Showdown: cards revealed
showdownReveal.body: The bot had K♠ Q♠: just a pair of Kings with a Queen kicker. Not bad, but not enough vs your flush.

rankings.title: The hand-rank ladder
rankings.body: Lowest to highest. Your flush (highlighted) beats the bot's pair. Each hand, the higher-ranked hand wins the pot.

showdownWin.title: You win the pot!
showdownWin.body: 1780 chips go back to your stack. Well played.

outro.title: You've finished the tutorial
outro.body: You now know the basics: positions, blinds, pre-flop, flop, turn, river, hand rankings, and showdown. Jump into a real bot game from the lobby anytime.
